text:
Lena Morales: hey team! first day today 👋 i’m lena — just joined eng onboarding. bringing homemade cheese & chive scones to the kitchen around 3pm. also bringing my ukulele if anyone wants a quick rooftop jam fri at 5? :ukulele:

Jess Liu: welcome lena!! excited. dairy ok? i'm lactose sensitive so maybe a veg option? :raised_hands:

Omar Z.: congrats! i'll bring a french press + oat milk :coffee: can you drop a note about heating? the oven in kitchen can be weird.

Lena Morales: yep, fyi for whoever reheats — `oven 350°F for 5-7m` or microwave 15s on low. i’ll leave a label. also happy to make GF next time if folks want.

Noah Kim: woo scones. rooftop jam sounds fun — i’m in for 5pm friday. which door do we meet at?

Lena Morales: meet by rooftop stairs near the art wall. should be noisy but fun :) (i'll bring tabs)

welcome-bot: Welcome to Redwood, Lena! Reminder: new-hire quick intro at 10am in #all-hands tomorrow :tada:

Jess Liu: also — who’s on snack rota this week? can chip in for napkins. :handshake:

Ava (People Ops): hey! i grabbed the rota, jen's on snack duty but glad to see extras — leave any leftovers in the labeled bin in the kitchen. :sparkles:

Omar Z.: great, see you later — lemme know if you want help hauling the ukulele case up the stairs. :guitar:

Lena Morales: thanks y'all! super excited to be here. see you at 3 and friday 5 :)
